title: Engine follows relay v11 process rules: gate close timing and [AFTER LAND] Check lines
lead: ork's engine settles when a v11 gate round closes with its verdict (owner question Q1), treats a Check line marked `[AFTER LAND]` as deferred to land (approval card and role prompts), and records which v11 process rules it already meets. The non-blocker owner question rule is a separate slice (`engine-v11-rules-2`).
findings_note: S198 preflight 2026-10-30: owner split the engine rules out of S198

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Split out of S198 on 2026-10-30 (owner, interactive) and re-scoped on 2026-10-31 after tracing each rule against the code. `slicer ai relay` and `slicer ai relay-orchestrator` print relay v11 today. This slice covers the rules below; the non-blocker owner question rule (S204's fourth bullet) is its own slice because it adds ledger calls, a record field and a read-back.

Rule by rule, as traced against HEAD of main on 2026-10-31 (line anchors re-checked on 2026-11-07 at a1114e2; the 2026-10-30 note's `round.go:400` is now `round.go:499-522`):

- **A small fix round is checked and gated in one pass by the read-only role that raised its findings** (`slicer ai relay-orchestrator`, Gate bullet). ork already runs no second review round after the first: `checks` jumps to `beforeGate` once a reviewer record exists (`internal/engine/states.go:237`, `beforeGate` at `:581`), and the gate resumes the reviewer's session (`resumeFrom`, `internal/engine/states.go:614-615`, brief section `:616`). `TestReviewFindingsStartAFixRoundAndTheResumedReviewerGatesIt` (`internal/engine/engine_test.go:362`) pins it. No code change. Whether this counts as "the role that raised the findings" is Q2; this slice only records the current behavior in the docs.
- **A clean merge of main is regated by the one-pass small-fix check on the merge diff** (`slicer ai relay`, Order and Land step 6). ork merges main in, renders, re-runs the project check command and `slicer check`, then fast-forwards with no role round (`mergeBaseIn`, `internal/engine/land.go:115-185`). The ledger run has already ended at the finish step (`internal/engine/states.go:750-785`, `endRelay` at `:784`), and relay-run refuses steps after that (S153, `internal/engine/land_test.go:617`). No code change here; Q2 asks whether to document this as a deviation or build a regate round.
- **A Check line marked `[AFTER LAND]` is deferred to Land step 6** (`slicer ai relay-orchestrator`, Every brief). The implementer and the gate do not run it, and the finish step does not wait for it. ork's prompts say nothing about it, so an implementer may try to run a line that needs a slice that has not landed. The approval card lists only `[HUMAN CHECK]` bullets (`humanCheckLine` and `humanCheckTexts`, `internal/engine/approval.go:8-27`), so a plain `- [AFTER LAND] ...` line never reaches the owner, and a `[HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND] ...` line shows as an ordinary open check that blocks approval until ticked (`internal/engine/engine.go:392`). This slice fixes both (Q3 asks whether ork should run such lines itself; this slice does not).
- **`relay-run list` `counts.roles` counts lane steps only** (`slicer ai relay`; `../slicer/src/slicer/relayrun.py:417-436`). ork decodes `Counts.Roles` (`internal/slicercli/types.go:167`) but never reads it: the only users of `Counts` read `Steps`, `Running` and `Waiting` (`internal/tui/overview.go:396-402,1267`, `internal/tui/runtree.go:390`, `internal/daemon/handlers.go:409`). No behavior change; the field comment says what it counts.
- **A gate round is closed with its verdict.** S198 sends it (`internal/engine/round.go:499-522`: `closeWithVerdict` at `:502`, the verdict close at `:515-521`). The step closes with the report's verdict before the engine knows whether it accepts the round. A gate report whose `TriageGate` fails (`round.go:535`, shape pause from `:545`), whose `## Owner needed` asks something (`round.go:568-580`), or that carries an `[owner blocker]` finding (`round.go:583-605`) pauses the slice with the verdict already recorded. On retry or answer the gate runs again as a new attempt with a new ledger step (`internal/engine/round.go:263-270`, `stepStart` at `round.go:678`, `stepEnd` at `:698`). Traced in slicer: `_measure` counts every gate-role lane step as a gate round, whatever its phase (`../slicer/src/slicer/relayrun.py:973-982`), so a retried gate is two gate rounds either way. What differs is the verdict. With the verdict on the first step, `with_verdict` counts it and `gate_fails` counts it when it says `fail`, although ork did not accept the round and wrote no `Review FAIL` note; the step's `verdict` shows a PASS the engine never acted on. With no verdict, `by_proxy` counts the round (`gates.by_proxy = gate_rounds - with_verdict`, `relayrun.py:1052`) and `gate_fails` counts it only if an implementer fix round follows it, which a retried gate is not (`relayrun.py:977-982`). The choice is Q1.

Three owner questions gate parts of this slice. Q1 (gate close timing): (a) keep the close as now, (b) close with the verdict only for a round the engine accepts, (c) close a paused round as `fail`; the draft recommends (b). Q2 (rules 1 and 2): (a) document rule 1 as met and rule 2 as a deviation, (b) build a one-pass gate round on a clean merge as its own slice; the draft recommends (a). Q3 (`[AFTER LAND]`): (a) list the line on the card for the owner, (b) run single-command lines at landing as its own slice; the draft recommends (a). The outer session records the answers as an `Owner decisions` paragraph on this slice before the worktree is cut (`slicer ai relay`, Setup). Until Q1 is answered, step 3 of Implement is not started; the rest follows the recommended answers.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Gate close (Q1 (b) only; under (a) add only the pinning test named last):

- `TestV11GateOwnerNeededClosesTheStepWithoutAVerdict` (`internal/engine/contract_v11_test.go`): a v11 run whose first gate report is `VERDICT: PASS` with a plain question under `## Owner needed` pauses with a `question` pending; the gate step's `--phase done` call carries no `--verdict`. After `e.Answer`, the second gate (new ledger step) returns `gatePass`; exactly one `relay-run step` call in the whole run carries `--verdict`, it is `pass`, and it is on the second gate step. Fails first: `round.go:515-521` sends `--verdict pass` on the first step.
- `TestV11GateTriageShapeErrorClosesTheStepWithoutAVerdict`: a v11 gate report `VERDICT: PASS` with a malformed `- [owner] Which one?` finding (as `TestMalformedOwnerFindingPausesOnAShapeError`, `internal/engine/kinds_test.go:205`) pauses with a `shape` pending; the first gate step carries no `--verdict`; `e.Retry` with `gatePass` leaves one `--verdict pass` in total. Fails first for the same reason.
- `TestV11GateBlockerFindingClosesTheStepWithoutAVerdict`: a v11 gate report `VERDICT: PASS` plus `blockerFinding` (`kinds_test.go:174` shape) pauses; the first gate step carries no `--verdict`; after `e.Answer` the second carries `pass`.
- `TestV11GateFailStillClosesWithVerdictFail` is the existing `TestV11GateFailClosesTheStepWithVerdictFail`; it must stay green (an accepted FAIL keeps its verdict).
- `TestV11GateStepCloseIsSingle` (a guard, green today): in the question case above, every gate step has exactly one `--phase done` call (no step closed twice by the restructure).
- Under Q1 (a) instead: `TestV11GateKeepsTheVerdictWhenTheRoundPauses` pins today's behavior (first step carries `--verdict pass`, two gate steps in the ledger). It passes today; it exists so the choice is recorded.

`[AFTER LAND]` Check lines (Q3 (a)):

- `TestCardListsAfterLandCheckLinesAsDeferred` (`internal/engine/approval_test.go`): a Check section with `- go test ./...`, `- [HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND] Run the workflow once.` and `- [AFTER LAND] slicer check --root ../slicer` gives a card with two human checks whose texts start `deferred to land: ` (the marker removed from the rest), each already in state `later`; `e.Approve` then succeeds with no marks made. Fails first: the plain line is not read, and the bracketed line is an open check with the marker kept in its text.
- `TestAfterLandLineOutsideTheCheckSectionIsIgnored`: an `[AFTER LAND]` bullet in the Why section adds no check.
- `TestAfterLandCheckKeepsTheOwnersMark`: the owner ticks the deferred check (`MarkCheck`), a fix round runs, the rebuilt card keeps `ticked`; a check the owner reopened (state empty) is not preset to `later` again. Fails first: no preset exists to test; the red line is the missing `later` state in the first assertion.
- `TestApprovalNoteNamesDeferredLines`: the checks note written at approval has `- later: deferred to land: ...` for the line.
- `TestImplementerAndGatePromptsSkipAfterLandLines` (`internal/roles/roles_test.go`): the implementer prompt says not to run a Check line marked `[AFTER LAND]` and that ork lists it for the owner; the gate prompt says it does not run or fail the slice on one. Fails first: neither prompt mentions the marker.
- `TestPromptsFirstLineNamesTheirContract` (`internal/roles/roles_test.go:195`) must stay green.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first for every step; watch each go red for the reason given above.

1. Re-anchor every line cited in Files against the worktree before editing. Run `slicer ai relay` and `slicer ai relay-orchestrator` and read the sentences that Why quotes; if v11's text has moved, stop and report.
2. Preflight with the owner: Q1, Q2 and Q3 above. Record each answer in the slice as an `Owner decisions` paragraph (the outer session does it before the worktree). Do not start steps 3 to 5 without them. Q2 and Q3 only choose the docs wording and whether step 4's card preset exists; if Q3 is (b) or Q2 is (b), report and stop: each is its own slice.
3. Gate close (waits on Q1). Under (b): in `internal/engine/round.go`, keep the v10 and non-gate close at `:503-505` as is. For a v11 gate round, hold the step open after the report is read, compute `verdict` once from `rep` (empty when `CheckReport` failed), and close it in exactly one place per exit: with `verdict` only on the path that returns `outcome{ok: true}`; with no verdict on the `statusErr` path, the shape-problem pause, the question pause, the blocker paths (including `answered blocker repeated` and an error from `askBlocker` or `recordFindings`). Use one small closure with a `closed` flag so no path closes twice or not at all; a test for the flag is `TestV11GateStepCloseIsSingle`. Under (a): change no code; add the pinning test and the design.md sentence only.
4. `[AFTER LAND]` (Q3 (a)). In `internal/engine/approval.go` add a second matcher for a bullet or numbered line of the slice's Check section (heading `Check`, case-insensitive, as `sliceTouchesUI` matches `Files` at `internal/engine/states.go:559`) that contains `[AFTER LAND]`, with or without a leading `[HUMAN CHECK]`. Its check text is `deferred to land: ` plus the line with both markers removed and spaces trimmed. Keep the order of lines; do not add the same line twice when it has both markers. In `buildCard`, a deferred check with no earlier mark of the same text starts in state `CheckLater` (use a lookup that tells "no mark" from "open": `marks` has an entry for every earlier check). Do not change `Approve`, `MarkCheck` or the TUI: the card text already shows the check and the owner can still tick it. Do not add a field to `runrec.HumanCheck` (the text prefix is the whole mark; a new field would change `run.json` for older readers, `docs/state.md`).
5. Role prompts. In `implementer.md` after the paragraph at `:116-118`, add two short sentences: a Check line marked `[AFTER LAND]` needs something main does not have yet; do not run it, and ork lists it for the owner. In `gate.md` step 3, add one fragment to the criteria list in the style of its neighbours (for example: "an `[AFTER LAND]` Check line is not run and not a failure;"). Keep the first line `relay v11` and the placeholders unchanged (`roles_test.go` checks both).
6. `internal/slicercli/types.go:167`: add the comment "counts lane steps only (relay v11); ork does not read it". No test.
7. Docs: `docs/design.md` gate bullet and `:1639-1642` (a v11 gate round closes with its verdict when the engine accepts the round; otherwise it closes without one; the retried round is a new ledger step), Review and gate (the gate is the resumed reviewer and gates a fix round in one pass: the v11 small-fix rule), Approval card (the deferred-to-land lines), `docs/state.md:386-392` (the same lines in `human_checks`), `docs/orchestrator-parity.md` (the rule table: rule 1 met, rule 2 as the owner decides in Q2, rule 3 listed on the card, rule 5 not read, the gate close). Refer to slicer's commands; do not paste the contract text. Mark each new behavior *proposed* until an adj record decides it.
8. CHANGELOG entry last, so a parallel slice's entry does not conflict: one bullet under `## Unreleased`, starting "S204:", marked *proposed*, naming the gate close and the `[AFTER LAND]` lines.

Do not touch `internal/tui`, `land.go`, `later.go`, `write.go` or any golden. No new dependency. SPDX header on any new Go file (none expected).

This is not a UI slice by its Files (no `internal/tui`, `internal/cli`, `docs/dashboard.md`, or `ui.*` key): no UI pass.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-07 (interview). Q1: close a v11 gate round with its verdict only once the engine accepts it (option b). Q2: document rule 1 as met and rule 2 as a deviation (option a). Q3 is still open.
